notes.problem: Car sunk in a flat black void; no ledges, brown water or bank; dead zone below the waterline.
notes.fix: Pale limestone ledges 6 to 10 m behind lit by the bank lamp; water brown at about 0.7 opacity with the ripple catching the lamp across the doors.

notes.problem: No water reads below the comal line; bokeh blobs; no ledges or far bank; cabin glass hot spots; foliage behind the dek.
notes.fix: Ripple normal and muddy brown albedo with the bank lamp's streak across the door line; ledges in the cone; lower glass envMap; move the tree right.

notes.problem: No floodwater; comal line reads as trim; black with blobs below; no bank.
notes.fix: Brown tinted rippled sheet at the beltline streaking the bank lamp; a lit limestone ledge behind.

notes.problem: Opaque black rectangle reads as a hole; green verge band.
notes.fix: Two streetlights behind the median mirrored as streaks; the sheet across both lanes with a comal edge.

notes.problem: Flat dark rectangle with a small blue parallelogram; mirrors nothing; olive verge.
notes.fix: Low roughness reflective water mirroring the lamps and the flank; comal a thin full-width edge; verge to near black.

notes.problem: Flat untextured dark quad reads as a cast shadow; ambiguous comal wedge.
notes.fix: A mirror with a light ripple normal reflecting lamps and the wheel; comal a thin leading edge.

notes.problem: Wheels read as dark stilts; the comal line reads as an overlay.
notes.fix: Seat the tyres with contact and a lit sidewall edge; break the comal line at the tyres.

notes.problem: Nose on exposes the slab bumper and disc wheels under a floating body; no headlamps.
notes.fix: Swing about 30 degrees to the front quarter; seat the body with contact; low emissive headlamps.

notes.problem: Toy car on a bookshelf; blinds as shelves; car lit blue; dead band under the dek.
notes.fix: A visible window frame; the car at street distance under sodium; screen top about 80 px under the dek.

notes.problem: Top 45 percent dead black; the window car reads as a toy on a shelf; generic books.
notes.fix: Push in so the monitor fills about half the frame height; stripe sodium light on the wall; drop the window car.

notes.problem: Box slabs with a dome dot; wide black aisles.
notes.fix: Lower the camera to about 9 m with a longer lens; bevel the low detail bodies and rake the windshield.

notes.problem: Flat side-on car on a pale orange wash; mid tone near half.
notes.fix: Camera at 1.0 m swung 20 degrees to a front three-quarter; a tight pool on the car, rider and curb.

notes.problem: Weak pool; the band is a ring on the ground; posts identical; February without a leader.
notes.fix: Tighter spot so lit posts read at L* 60 or more; comal on the post's band; a leader for February.
